players.product: physics-plus-AI molecular discovery platform and Bunsen co-scientist

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K pipeline: Schrödinger is advancing its MALT1 inhibitor, SGR-1505, for the treatment of patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies; it is aware of several MALT1 inhibitors in clinical development, including by AbbVie, HotSpot Therapeutics and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, as well as approved and clinical-stage bi-specifics and CAR-Ts for B-cell lymphomas.

10-K: on August 15, 2024 co-founded collaborator Morphic Holding was acquired by Eli Lilly for $57.00 per share, or approximately $3.2 billion; Schrödinger received $47.6 million for the 834,968 Morphic shares it owned and is also entitled to low single-digit royalties on the clinical development programs under its Morphic collaboration agreement, including MORF-057.
quarterly_data.figure: $47.6 million for 834,968 shares; Lilly-Morphic approximately $3.2 billion; low single-digit royalties incl. MORF-057
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: co-founded drug discovery collaborator (acquired by Eli Lilly); royalty payer on clinical programs
